An '''account of the Discovery of Korriban''' was recorded in [[Language/Legends|scripture]] on a stone tablet and existed as a memorabilia of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] by<ref name="TOR" /> [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Dates" />

==Behind the scenes==
The account of the Discovery of Korriban appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a companion gift.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
